project_name: Digi Power X / Omnis Pleasants AI infrastructure partnership
aliases: ARMS modular Tier III data center platform at Pleasants
developer: Digi Power X Inc.; Omnis Pleasants LLC
status_detail: Digi Power X announced a non-binding LOI with Omnis Pleasants, owner of the 1.3 GW Pleasants Power Station, for load/interconnection study up to 1.3 GW and potential lease of up to 200 acres for modular Tier III AI/HPC data centers; later bankruptcy coverage shows Omnis Pleasants filed Chapter 11 in July 2026, so execution risk is high.
notes: Capacity is the announced power/load-study scale, not confirmed IT load. County official site was checked; project evidence came from company release syndication and local bankruptcy reporting, not county approval records.
